description.zh:
新设置的网络带宽。单位：mbps。取值范围：大于当前值~200。
> 
> - 必须指定该参数
> - 带宽峰值不作为业务承诺指标，仅作为参考值和带宽上限峰值。
description.en:
The new network bandwidth. Unit: Mbit/s. Valid values: a value that is greater than the current bandwidth up to 200.

> - This parameter is required.
> - The peak bandwidth is for reference only and does not indicate a service level agreement (SLA). It specifies the upper limit of the bandwidth.

title.zh: 扩容网关数据公网带宽

descriptions.zh:
调用该接口时，您需要注意：

当网关所在地域与目标 OSS Bucket 所在地域不一致时，需通过此接口完成扩容操作以实现跨地域挂载。
descriptions.en:
When you call this operation, note the following:

If the gateway and the target OSS bucket are in different regions, you must call this operation to expand the public bandwidth for cross-region mounting.
